card.title: IPhone 16 Pro Max Restarting When Opening Camera App

source.title: IPhone 16 Pro Max Restarting When Opening Camera App

claims.statement: iPhone 16 Pro rebooting as soon as the camera starts, despite restore and new camera modules, has been traced to a damaged or missing crystal capacitor under the CPU, needing CPU removal to repair.

procedure: Remove CPU; replace the damaged/missing crystal capacitor; refit.
card.caveats: Specialist CPU-level repair; designator not given. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
